title: The Queen's Weather Forecast
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Conan, Officer Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancy vs. old cases/ep789 file: the old file names Hiroko Shinohara (s3) as murderer_id. The transcript does not support this -- Shinohara only rigged a harmless tinsel-and-balloon scare trap near a rose-thorn prop, and Kogoro explicitly rules out that this could have caused a fatal fall on its own. The actual killer is producer Yukio Kodama, who was being blackmailed by Yasumi over embezzled production funds: he secretly told Yasumi about Shinohara's prank in advance (so she would walk toward it unafraid and stand near the railing 'for safety'), then remotely fired a carbon-dioxide fog machine at her from close range, blinding her so she staggered backward through a railing he had pre-loosened. He is unmasked via (1) brown shoe-polish cream, still wet from the day's drizzle, transferred onto the fog machine when he repositioned its nozzle afterward, (2) the wireless remote for the machine found on his person, and (3) Yasumi's own dying message -- a weather symbol for snow scratched in blood, pointing at the 'yuki' (snow) in Yukio's name. case_type: murder (charged as accidental death until Kogoro's deduction).

clues.desc: Brown shoe-polish cream, still wet from that day's drizzle and humidity, found on the fog machine's nozzle matches the cream on Kodama's freshly polished brown shoes -- proof he touched the machine after the crime.
Only the left side of Yasumi's hair was disheveled and her hairpin flew all the way to the far wall -- both point to a gas blast from her left side, toward where the loosened railing was.
Yasumi told Kogoro she would not check the stage before her break, yet she went and checked it anyway and set off the trap -- meaning someone had told her about the trap beforehand.
The dying message is the weather symbol for snow ('yuki'); of the three suspects, only Yukio Kodama has 'yuki' (snow) in his name.

secretly warned her about Shinohara's balloon trap and told her standing near the railing would keep her safe
